The edges of a job: what is in, and what is left out
n: Scope is the edge of a job: what is in and what is out. An AI tool will happily do more than you meant, or less, if you never say where the job stops. Before you ask for anything big, write the scope in two lines. First, what done looks like. Second, what to leave alone. "Tidy this report. Do not change any numbers." That second line does as much work as the first. A clear scope is how you get back the thing you asked for.
